attr.title: Moida Mansion
attr.desc: An authentic retro LCD handheld game created by Lucas Pope (Papers, Please / Return of the Obra Dinn). Explore a procedural haunted mansion, rescue your three trapped friends, find hidden keys and crown buttons, and evade the terrifying Monsta!
attr.inst: D-Pad Left/Right to move rooms, D-Pad Up or X to climb stairs, D-Pad Down or B to search. START for Pause Menu, SELECT for 12-page Manual.
